soldier: The soldier is mainly brown tinged with red, the frontal region purplish brown, the mandibles a deeper purplish brown, labrum, antennae and anteclypeus yellowish brown; the postmentum the same colour as the head capsule, deeper in the anterior section and paler in the posterior, pronotum yellowish brown and deeper along the anterior margin, abdomen pale brown, the tenth abdominal tergite again yellowish brown. The margins of the thoracic and abdominal tergites and the antennal segments with scattered short hairs, the head capsule especially sparsely haired. Head capsule cylindrical, slightly less high than wide, the sides slightly expanding backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; the frontal surface densely covered with fine dots, the frontal angle slightly raised and bearing about three shallow longitudinal striae, the frontal surface slightly depressed, the Y-shaped suture blurred, the frontal slope steeper than 50 degrees, the eye spots obscure. Labrum nearly square, its tip straight; mandibles rather short, each with four marginal teeth, the last on the left and the third and fourth on the right only minute projections. Antennae with 9–11 segments, the second or third shortest. Postmentum short and broad, its posterior margin slightly arched and straight in the middle, in profile its anterior half distinctly separated from the ventral margin of the head capsule. The anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.
